scope: Generated Text-Fabric browser presentation, measured heavy-feature preload policy, feature-help integration contract, and real generated-app browser usability.

conclusions: Exclude catalogue_json, gdl_json, sign_json from ordinary browser preload while keeping their TF files explicitly loadable.
The old data-only root/export 500s are a non-browse characterization-harness artifact; product acceptance must use generated app: discovery in browse mode.
Text-Fabric 13.1 supports the required preload, typeDisplay, and featureBase policy declaratively.
Feature help is an outbound URL; #73 defines a stable shipped-repository URL contract and #81 validates the actual staged docs bundle.
